name: .416 Cal-325gr Stone Hammer®
note: Required twist rate for Dangerous Game is 1-16″ or faster. Required twist for Big Game Hunting is 1-18″ or faster. Recommended use: Dangerous Game Hunting / Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "This Stone Hammer™ has a 3mm hollow point with some extra thickness around the hollow point, for increased petal weight, that will aid in penetration on thick skinned dangerous game animals that will result in large deep wound channels. This pure copper hunting bullet will work well for any big game up through the big dangerous game animals of the Dark Continent. Designed with the 416 Rigby in mind this Stone Hammer™ will work well in any of the 416’s."
